title: Card stack fan into a vertical filmstrip reel
summary: A dot grows into a small rounded image card, fans into a column of four, folds back, then the front card grows to full bleed. Four full-bleed images slide down one after another under a rolling index number, closing on a framed title card.
use_when: A vertical portfolio or gallery reel of 3-6 strong images or app screens
Social or store asset where the visuals carry the message and copy is one title
Opening a showcase by previewing every item at once before showing each full screen
Silent autoplay where motion alone has to read as a sequence

look.type_style: bold grotesk, all caps, tight leading, title lines about 3.5 % of H on the end card; index label medium grotesk, rotated 90 degrees, about 4 % of H, bottom-left; tiny caps URL about 0.6 % of H

sfx.event: card stack fans open and folds back
front card grows to full bleed
next full-bleed image slides down over the previous one

structure.shot: dark bg, 4 corner tick dots frame a dot that becomes a small rounded image card; fans into a column of 4 cards, folds back, front card grows to fill
structure.camera: static frame; subject scale grows 0.27 W to 1.00 W (card to full bleed) over 3.00-3.53
structure.motion: dot to card 0.27-0.50 springs.pop (overshoot not measurable); fan open 1.00-1.50 springs.layout 15 fr; hold 1.50-2.27; fold 2.27-2.77 springs.ui 15 fr; grow to bleed 3.00-3.53 easings.inOutCubic 16 fr (±0.25 s); ticks track the card bounds

structure.shot: image 1 full bleed, index label 01 rotated at bottom-left
structure.camera: push-in 1.00->1.03 across the hold (±0.25 s), easings.linear
structure.motion: index label appears with the bleed at 3.50; next image enters from the top edge at 4.30 and pushes this one down, easings.inOutCubic 24 fr (4.30-5.10)

structure.shot: image 2 full bleed, index rolls to 02
structure.motion: index digit rolls during the slide (±0.25 s); next slide 5.30-6.00, easings.inOutCubic 21 fr

structure.shot: image 3 full bleed, index rolls to 03
structure.motion: index digit roll with the slide (±0.25 s); next slide 6.60-7.10, easings.inOutCubic 15 fr

structure.shot: image 4 full bleed, index rolls to 04
structure.motion: index digit roll with the slide (±0.25 s); last slide brings the dark end card down from the top 7.57-8.03, easings.inOutCubic 14 fr

structure.shot: dark end card: 2-line caps title, then a 2-line caps sub-block, then a tiny URL, inside 4 corner tick dots
structure.camera: static; tick frame grows taller as lines are added
structure.motion: title in with the slide at 8.00; sub-block lands at 8.27 and the stack re-centres up, springs.ui 8 fr (±0.25 s); URL at 8.50 fade 8 fr (±0.25 s); ticks springs.layout; hold 8.50-9.17

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the dark open and end card, fg for type and ticks, display font for title and index
params.content.images: 3-6 full-bleed portrait images or app screens; the first is the front card of the stack
params.content.title: end-card title, 2 short caps lines
params.content.sub: 2-line caps sub-block under the title (series code, category)
params.content.url: tiny URL under the sub-block; defaults to brand.url
params.index.format: rotated index label pattern, default slash + 2-digit number
params.timing.holds: frames each full-bleed image holds before its slide (measured 38, 28, 36, 29 at 30 fps)
params.timing.slides: slide-push length per image (measured 24, 21, 15, 14 fr: each slide shorter)
params.aspect: 9:16 native; 4:5 and 1:1 keep the column stack but with 3 cards

notes: Zero hard cuts: all 5 boundaries are soft (cuts.json soft[]). Slides run top to bottom (motion.json pan +600..+1140 px/s at 1920 W) and get shorter each time (24, 21, 15, 14 fr), which reads as acceleration. The index label stays fixed on screen while the images move; only its digits change. Catalogue hint 3d-device/device-phone not confirmed: no device frame, cards are flat rounded rectangles. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): stack-fan, corner-ticks. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (source is silent). Palette from palettegen on 3 cut frames; the white text colour is not in the sample.
